Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly stated that James Kirkwood Sr.'s death date was "April 21, 1989" instead of the correct date of "August 24, 1963." This error occurred because the Planner failed to properly verify the information from the WebSurfer's results and confused James Kirkwood Sr. (the director of "A Dream or Two Ago") with James Kirkwood Jr. (a playwright and author who died in 1989). This incorrect death date led to subsequent confusion and delays in accurately comparing the death dates of the two directors, which impacted the resolution of the real-world problem.
